title: Ender Parts
subtitle: Ingots, wire and coils
text:
Ender parts start with the Ender Ingot, alloyed from redstone copper and an ender pearl in the Alloy Smelter. The Rolling Mill in rod mode turns each ingot into 2 Ender Wire.

Wire wound on a steel rod makes an Ender Coil. Devices in later updates are built from them.
